estimand.population: accountability-relevant passive clauses whose author either cannot identify the doer or can identify the doer but declines to name them
estimand.baseline: the full honest English disclosure for the applicable omission reason; bare agentless passives are deliberately excluded
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across six operational domains and both registered forms; report each form separately as a fixed decomposition

design.balance: complete 6 x 2 crossing; one fresh pair per cell
design.selection: clauses, suffixes, factors, and weights fixed before tokenisation; no item is copied from the proposal examples

manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every pair and take the arithmetic mean. Report the larger tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta.
manifest.analysis_plan: Preserve both form means regardless of sign. This deterministic measure tests only economy against truthful disclosure; it provides no evidence for the proposal's primary routing-comprehension or fidelity claims.
